parameters.query: SELECT a.id, a.url, a.title, a.author, LEFT(a.raw_content, 8000) as content, s.name as source_name FROM articles a LEFT JOIN sources s ON s.id = a.source_id WHERE a.status = 'summarizing' ORDER BY a.created_at ASC LIMIT 10
